events.title: Highlands Ranch Mansion 2026 Holiday Celebration — Free Horse-Drawn Hayrides and Historic Mansion Access
events.location: Highlands Ranch Mansion, 9950 E Gateway Dr, Highlands Ranch, Colorado 80126, USA
events.cost: FREE for all listed activities; 2 adults + 3 children = $0 mandatory admission/activity fee. Food trucks optional and paid; travel/off-site transport or parking cost not stated.
events.age: Public family event, no stated age, residency or citizenship restriction. Horse-drawn hayride vehicle seating limit and queue capacity not specified; 5 people riding together not guaranteed.
events.description: One-day Highlands Ranch Metro District-supported heritage family outing with genuine horse-drawn hayrides (not a normal retail paid horse activity), public self-guided access inside Highlands Ranch Mansion, outdoor reindeer games, face painting and seasonal activities. The organizer explicitly states all activities FREE; unlike normal mansion open hours, the horse-drawn rides are scheduled only with the celebration. Parking at the Mansion prohibited except disability placards; off-site parking/transport planned but precise pick-up location not yet published. Organizer event listing verifies date, hours and age-neutral public invitation. No advance reservation requirement listed, ride capacity unverified. Useful to Colorado-local friends in 2026; outside 2027-28 family stay.
